feature_name: Windmill direct ladders and two-tick middle-floor menu

source_references.revision: Protected local archive, upstream commit unavailable; configured241

provenance.basis: Independent adaptation of five explicit source windmill ladder operations and their distinct direct/menu delays, exact native aliases/operations and existing actor-owned choice/climb systems. No donor code, configuration or assets copied.
restrictions: Root ISC does not establish blanket per-file or dependency clearance.
Protected source/native/cache/Wiki/private and historical evidence stays local. Mill hopper/flour processing, quests, other ladders and generic no-native choice content remain separate.

registration_dispatch.role: Attest exact native12964/12965/12966 geometry and all operations, then produce four one-tick direct climbs and one middle menu.
Actual startup refuses conflicts before installing the five-operation batch.
Reached middle operation1 preserves its source arrival flag and enters an actor-owned location choice.
Capture actor-relative plus/minus1 level destinations with the exact source title/options and delayed climb followup.
After valid selected reply, consume/close choice and reuse the checked protected climb entry; immediate spiral choice remains a separate Jump followup.
Small typed immediate/delayed followup stays in the existing actor continuation; no new actor field/global scheduler.

dependencies: ENV: existing native location choice renderer/token/close eligibility and authoritative protected climb continuation, movement/occupancy and saved-coordinate synchronization.
expected_normal_behavior: Bottom12964 operation1 climbs one level; middle12965 operation2 climbs and operation3 descends one; top12966 operation1 descends one. All four direct operations arrive, animate828 for both directions, wait one protected tick and keep the actor x/z.

Middle12965 operation1 arrives and opens title Climb up or down the ladder? with Climb Up. and Climb Down. in that order. Choice1/2 uses server-owned actor-relative plus/minus1 level, emits animation828 and waits two protected ticks before movement.

Consume and close the selected menu before starting the existing protected Climb continuation. Dialogue token becomes unavailable while the delayed climb runs, so a stale opposite reply cannot change the selected destination. Existing spiral menu still jumps immediately and retains its own text/translation.

Use existing authoritative movement/occupancy, saved coordinates, synchronization and climb trace. No fake NPC, inventory change, XP, RNG, sound, model mutation, global scheduler or persistent schema.
expected_negative_behavior: Wrong aliases/static geometry/operation list/sequence or handler conflicts refuse the entire batch. Do not infer middle/right-click operations from name alone or use the generic downward827 animation here.

Wrong/stale token, invalid choice, genuine Close, stale location generation, invalid selected destination and canceled/moved/saving/logout/dead/modal actor must not replay a destination. Selected two-tick warmup retains shared held-action and lifecycle cancellation.

Do not replace actor-relative destinations with location-relative spiral landings, immediate jump after menu, one-tick menu delay or two-floor shortcuts. Existing immediate spiral and NPC/tool choice behavior must remain intact.

title: Climb up or down the ladder?

timing: All five source operations request arriveDelay. Four direct climbs animate828/delay1; the middle menu animates828/delay2 only after a valid choice. Waiting for the menu does not itself begin a climb.
Generic source approach/movement-cycle ordering remains a V4 obligation. Immediate spiral choice keeps Jump; windmill uses typed Climb followup.
transactions: Reuse existing actor-owned token, captured target generation, origin/last movement and two server destinations. Invalid choice keeps the valid menu; replay cannot replace a consumed selection.

After selection, close the menu and dispatch through start_fixed_location_climb with the selected checked actor-relative coordinate, animation828 and delay2. That existing continuation validates the target/origin/lifecycle again before authoritative movement.

No new player field or persistence/schema is added. ChoiceAfter selects actual immediate or delayed consumers within existing pending_location_action; old generic choice cancellation remains authoritative.

required_verification_levels.reason: Exact three native ladders/five operations, all-direct828 and source1/2 delay metadata, actual startup/dispatch/native choice and executable compilation.

Menu title/order, both actor-relative choices, exact two-tick warmup/animation, token consumption/opposite replay, close/held/stale/logout/modal cancellation; existing immediate spiral and other choice-family regressions.
Native all five operations, direct1 versus menu2 timing and828 animation, correct floor/position/GPI, genuine Close and stale ResumePause controls.
Both menu wait and selected protected warmup interruption, held action, movement, logout/reconnect/death/modal, saved landing and no transient token replay.
Pinned WindmillLadderScript and native definitions against Wiki Ladder/Mill Lane Mill traversal context; exact labels, direct/menu timing and source approach semantics need independent observation.

known_limitations: Independent native UI/animation/floor/scene/GPI and lifecycle/reference acceptance remains pending. Working-tree development checks do not establish actual native or pristine acceptance.

Common host static movement-cycle/arrival policy remains; exact source/native approach and selected-warmup interruption timing require V4.

observed_in_source: WindmillLadderScript registers bottom/top first operations and middle first/second/third. Direct climbs are actor-relative plus/minus1 level, source arriveDelay, animation828 and delay1 for either direction.
Middle first menu source exact title/options selects actor-relative destination, emits828 and delays2. It is not the spiral menu and does not immediately telejump after reply.
wiki_supported: Pinned Ladder/Mill Lane Mill pages support floor traversal/location context; they do not independently prove the exact source title, animation or1/2 tick distinction.
intentional_adaptations: Small typed ChoiceAfter reuses current actor choice/token/lifecycle state and171 checked protected climb entry. Source-specific labels/destinations/timing remain distinct; no NPC/global engine or actor persistence is introduced.
inferred_or_unresolved: Independent genuine native menu/Close/ResumePause, direct/menu timing, floor/GPI and lifecycle/source comparison; unrelated mill/quest content remains open.
